feePolicy.title: Fee Policy Management
feePolicy.description: Manage unified payment fee policies (rate + flat fee) and their assignments
feePolicy.totalFeeHint: Total fee = rate × face amount + flat fee (split between payer and payee)
feePolicy.defaultImmutable: The standard (DEFAULT) policy cannot be disabled
feePolicy.feeExceedsHint: This flat fee may exceed the face amount for small payments

validation.policyKeyFormat: Policy key may only contain uppercase letters, digits, and underscores
validation.flatFeeNonNegative: Flat fee must be 0 or greater
validation.feeZeroNotAllowed: Rate and flat fee cannot both be 0
validation.alreadyExists: A policy with the same key already exists (please update it)
validation.notFound: The fee policy was not found

assignment.title: Fee Assignments
assignment.applyNote: Assignment changes apply only to new charges (existing transactions are unaffected)
assignment.duplicate: An assignment with the same conditions already exists
assignment.policyDisabled: The assigned fee policy is disabled
